model.name: english_tinystories_c1024_l6
model.description: v0.1.1 open English. C=512 L=6 H=8 head=128 T=64, layer stream, GPT-2 residual scale 1/sqrt(2L). Vocab is the 0.1.0 TinyStories BPE plus <|endofstory|>. Fresh weights. Do not --resume english_tinystories_c256_l6 or the 2000 smoke. 2 GB cap hardcoded.

metadata.description: v0.1.1. Story-packed TinyStories: <|endofstory|> between stories, windows stay inside one story, short stories padded. 16384 tokens per optimizer step (batch 4 x accum 16 x T 256). Fresh init. Pass --steps as the cosine length. Do not --resume a finished budget to extend it.
